policy: Apply reviewed publication projects and primary-citation years consistently without modifying captured content. Unlisted records retain audited source projects/year. publication-a-cryogenic-apparatus-for-co.title: A cryogenic apparatus for coupling two-dimensional materials to a confocal multimode optical cavity
publication-a-cryogenic-apparatus-for-co.evidence: 2026 apparatus couples cryogenic two-dimensional van der Waals materials/transition-metal dichalcogenides to a confocal multimode cavity. This is CavMat, not atom-chip magnetometry.

publication-superradiant-charge-density-.title: Superradiant Charge Density Waves in a Driven Cavity-Matter Hybrid
publication-superradiant-charge-density-.evidence: 2026 theory proposes optically driven transition-metal dichalcogenides inside a cavity, controlling electronic charge-density order: CavMat.
publication-superradiant-charge-density-.yearEvidence: Nature primary article page reports published 19 October 2026 and cites Nat Commun (2026), DOI 10.1038/s41467-026-78382-3. It is an early accepted manuscript; no volume or article number is supplied. Preserve arXiv:2603.28432.

publication-raman-phonon-polariton-conde.title: Raman-phonon-polariton condensation in a transversely pumped cavity
publication-raman-phonon-polariton-conde.evidence: 2024 theory couples Raman-active material phonons to cavity photons and evaluates transition-metal dichalcogenide parameters: CavMat.

publication-a-scanning-quantum-cryogenic.title: A scanning quantum cryogenic atom microscope at 6 K
publication-a-scanning-quantum-cryogenic.evidence: 2021 paper explicitly describes SQCRAMscope cryogenic and atom-chip improvements, reaching 5.7 K; not CavMat cavity-material coupling.

publication-nematic-transitions-in-iron-.title: Nematic Transitions in Iron-Pnictide Superconductors Imaged with a Quantum Gas
publication-nematic-transitions-in-iron-.evidence: 2020 primary preprint explicitly uses SQCRAMscope BEC magnetometry plus birefringence imaging to study iron-pnictide nematicity.

publication-a-scanning-quantum-cryogenic.title: A Scanning Quantum Cryogenic Atom Microscope
publication-a-scanning-quantum-cryogenic.evidence: 2017 paper introduces SQCRAMscope, a scanning probe magnetometer employing a magnetically levitated BEC.

publication-trapping-ultracold-gases-nea.title: Trapping ultracold gases near cryogenic materials with rapid reconfigurability
publication-trapping-ultracold-gases-nea.evidence: 2013 atom-chip apparatus places ultracold atoms near exchangeable cryogenic samples and independently controls sample temperature. SQCRAMscope precursor; Rb species alone does not make this the Rubidium cavity project.

publication-imaging-topologically-protec.title: Imaging topologically protected transport with quantum degenerate gases
publication-imaging-topologically-protec.evidence: 2012 proposal uses atom-chip microscopy of current flow near topological-insulator surfaces. SQCRAMscope sensing precursor, not CavMat optical cavity control.

publication-fabrication-of-micro-magneti.title: Fabrication of Micro-Magnetic Traps for Cold Neutral Atoms
publication-fabrication-of-micro-magneti.evidence: 2003 Caltech/pre-LevLab atom-chip fabrication methods paper: lithographic microwires make magnetic traps for neutral atoms. Retain as historical SQCRAMscope/atom-chip foundation per user direction and original combined-project association, not as a CavMat paper or a report of the later SQCRAMscope instrument. Preserve its separate Pre-LevLab metadata.
